prompt: Use case: identity-preserve narrative restaging. First inputs canonical identity portraits; next room master is only architectural/palette reference; LAST input is prior scene for cast, approved face morphology and exact task content, NOT a pose to preserve. Preserve each canonical face, adult age, hair, eye/nose/jaw proportions and characteristic accessories. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye; Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear; Nazari and Mirza have no eyewear. Balanced stylized adult head/body scale, neither oversized heads nor realistic tiny heads. Clean cel-shaded adventure-comic linework, natural supported anatomy, two arms per character. Restage Farah discovering a mismatch at the lab bench, alone and actively investigating. Camera diagonally beside her small work console reveals a natural three-quarter profile, not front-facing. She has set her tablet down and leans slightly forward, one hand bracing the desk while her stylus circles the combination status. Her eyes narrow with curiosity and one eyebrow rises in concern. Remove the lecture-sized wallboard and switch it off. The single compact angled console shows three short rows: Amplitude: normal; Frequency: normal; Phase: normal. Beneath them, a subtle amber outline around Combination unseen in eleven days. Small task note Check feature relationships. This is a qualitative mission observation, no made-up values or probability. All type and rules follow the console plane, not flat pasted text. Tablet now face down on the bench, other monitors inactive. Natural shoulders, two continuous arm chains, realistic stylus grip and supporting palm. Preserve her exact canonical adult face, hair, left-eye lens and balanced head size. Dim sage pillar, aged brass instruments, charcoal surfaces, warm skin, no neon. Output one full 1536x1024 scene. No text outside genuine work artifacts, no captions, no hero portraits, no camera-facing eye contact or lesson cards.
